#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Import the TOS brief's source papers into Zotero, via the running app.

Why this script exists rather than Claude just doing it: the Zotero WEB key on this
machine is read-only (`write: false`), and Claude's sandbox refuses POSTs to local
services ("External System Writes"). Zotero being open opens a path that is genuinely
different - the connector endpoint the browser extension uses - but it has to be run
by Eric, not by the agent. This is that one command.

    python import_to_zotero.py            # dry run: fetch, show, write nothing
    python import_to_zotero.py --go       # actually import into Zotero
    python import_to_zotero.py --go --all # all 109, not just the priority four

Zotero must be open. Nothing here touches the web API or syncs anything; it hands
metadata to the local app exactly as the browser connector does, and Zotero then does
its own thing with it, including trying for an open-access PDF when it can.

AFTER importing, two more steps matter, because metadata alone does not help:

  1. Attach the PDFs. The verifier reads page-level text; an item with no PDF is
     still unusable to it. Behind a paywall this needs the Baylor proxy, i.e. you.
  2. Re-index: `sync_zotero_library` with `include_fulltext: true`, then check with
     `python ../source.py <item key>` - it should list pages.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CONNECTOR = "http://127.0.0.1:23119/connector"
EFETCH = (
    "https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi"
    "?db=pubmed&rettype=medline&retmode=text&id={ids}"
)

PRIORITY = {
    "40673787": "Kamarajugadda - misquote 1, exceedance rate read as volume share",
    "36003968": "Takaba - misquote 2, 53% increase called 'roughly doubles'",
    "39844736": "Ulman - misquote 3, 49.9% variance misattributed",
    "40132734": "Talutis - the denominator the statistical section needs",
}


def fetch(pmids: list[str]) -> str:
    """MEDLINE records for these PMIDs, in one polite request."""
    url = EFETCH.format(ids=",".join(pmids))
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        url, headers={"User-Agent": "TypeSafe_Sandbox TOS import (one-off)"}
    )
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response:
        return response.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")


def zotero_awake() -> bool:
    try:
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            f"{CONNECTOR}/ping", data=b"{}",
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST",
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
            return response.status == 200
    except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError):
        return False


def send(medline: str) -> tuple[int, str]:
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        f"{CONNECTOR}/import",
        data=medline.encode("utf-8"),
        headers={
            "Content-Type": "text/plain",
            "Zotero-Connector-API-Version": "2",
        },
        method="POST",
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=120) as response:
            return response.status, response.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")[:400]
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        return error.code, error.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")[:400]


def titles_in(medline: str) -> list[str]:
    out, current = [], []
    for line in medline.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("TI  - "):
            current = [line[6:].strip()]
        elif current and line.startswith("      "):
            current.append(line.strip())
        elif current:
            out.append(" ".join(current))
            current = []
    if current:
        out.append(" ".join(current))
    return out


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--go", action="store_true", help="actually import")
    parser.add_argument("--all", action="store_true",
                        help="all 109 PMIDs, not just the priority four")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.all:
        pmids = [
            line.strip() for line in
            (HERE / "PMIDS_ALL.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
            if line.strip()
        ]
    else:
        pmids = list(PRIORITY)

    print(f"{len(pmids)} PMID(s) to import")
    if not args.all:
        for pmid, why in PRIORITY.items():
            print(f"  {pmid}  {why}")
    print()

    print("fetching metadata from PubMed...")
    records = []
    for start in range(0, len(pmids), 25):       # batches, to stay polite
        chunk = pmids[start:start + 25]
        records.append(fetch(chunk))
        if start + 25 < len(pmids):
            time.sleep(0.5)
    medline = "\n".join(records)
    found = titles_in(medline)
    print(f"  {len(found)} record(s) returned")
    for title in found[:6]:
        print(f"    - {title[:74]}")
    if len(found) > 6:
        print(f"    ... and {len(found) - 6} more")

    if len(found) < len(pmids):
        print(f"\n  WARNING: asked for {len(pmids)}, got {len(found)}. "
              "A PMID may be wrong or withdrawn.")

    if not args.go:
        print("\nDRY RUN. Nothing was written. Re-run with --go to import.")
        return 0

    if not zotero_awake():
        print("\nZotero is not answering on 127.0.0.1:23119. Open it and retry.",
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    print("\nimporting into Zotero...")
    status, body = send(medline)
    print(f"  HTTP {status}")
    if body.strip():
        print(f"  {body.strip()[:300]}")
    if status not in (200, 201):
        print("\nImport did not succeed. Nothing else to undo - Zotero either took "
              "the records or it did not.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    print("\nImported. Two things still to do, and they are the ones that matter:")
    print("  1. Attach the PDFs. Metadata alone is not enough - the verifier reads")
    print("     page text. Paywalled ones need the Baylor proxy.")
    print("  2. Re-index: sync_zotero_library with include_fulltext: true,")
    print("     then `python ../source.py <item key>` should list pages.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
